svg.aria-label: Colophon. One engineer, one repository, one very opinionated build pipeline. A new issue every morning. Corrections: In our last release we shipped a console.log to production. We regret the error. We do not regret the three-hour debugging session that built character. Set in Newsreader, Libre Franklin & IBM Plex Mono. Typeset in Python, printed by GitHub Actions every morning at 06:00 IST.
